title: Observability: token-level KV metrics + logging + dashboards and alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: customers and SREs frequently asked for finer-grained token-level cost/latency breakdowns tied to KV cache behavior to explain tail latency and token unit cost. Motivation: reduce alert noise, make cost attribution actionable, and surface KV cache inefficiencies that increase per-token compute. Summary: add token-level KV hit/miss metrics, instrument KV code paths with tracing spans and structured JSON logging, add Grafana dashboards for token cost and KV hit/miss breakdowns, and retune alerting rules to use aggregated signals with sampled per-customer followups. Design highlights: (1) new metrics: redwood.kv.token_hits, redwood.kv.token_misses, redwood.tokens.cost_ms_bucket (histograms exported with token-category labels); (2) tracing: add kv.cache.lookup span with tags for cache_key_prefix and sampled customer_id (redacted) and adjustable sampling via feature flag; (3) logging: switch KV event logs to structured JSON to enable log-based metrics, remove sensitive keys, and include sampling_id for cross-correlation; (4) dashboards: token_cost_latency.json and kv_cache_overview.json with panels for aggregate and per-model token cost, KV hit-rate by prefix, and correlation panels for cost vs KV-miss ratio; (5) alerts: replace the noisy per-customer immediate alert with a two-tier rule — an aggregate signal that triggers pager when >3% sustained token-cost regression cluster-wide, and a sampled per-customer alert that creates a low-priority paged ticket for further analysis. Migration: metrics are backward-compatible; dashboards live in grafana folder and require no behavioral changes to runtime. Feature flag: obs.token_kv_enriched (default off for 24h), rollout plan below. Testing: unit tests for metric emission, integration tests that exercise KV miss/hit counters, manual dashboard review using local Grafana, and synthetic load test to validate alert thresholds. Linear/Jira: ENG-2256; SUP-3421. Impact: improves debugging of cost/latency regressions and should reduce noisy SRE alerts by ~70% according to simulated workload. Rollout: feature-flagged, 5% of traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 72 hours with metric and alert observation windows. Checklist: implement metrics + logging + tracing; add dashboards; update alert rules; add docs; smoke test on staging; gradual rollout; monitor.
commits: Add token-level KV hit/miss counters and token cost histogram
Instrument KV lookup path with tracing spans and sampling control
Migrate KV event logs to structured JSON, redact keys, add sampling_id
Add Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency and KV cache overview
Add alert rules: aggregate regression alert + sampled per-customer followups
Tests: unit + integration tests for metrics; update mocks and CI configs
